meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: A fast Rust-based headless browser automation CLI with Node.js fallback that enables AI agents to navigate, click, type, and snapshot pages via structured commands.

copy.tagline: 用结构化命令自动操控浏览器页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要让AI自动操作浏览器完成点击、输入和截图。
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser pages with structured commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI to automatically click, type, and snapshot web pages.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以自动控制浏览器：打开网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图、录制视频等。它会用命令行工具 agent-browser 执行这些操作，并返回页面内容或截图结果。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 自动操作网页、提取页面数据、填写表单或测试网页界面时触发。

say.note: Claude 会打开网页并保存截图。

say.text: 帮我登录网站，用户名是 user，密码是 pass
say.note: Claude 会打开登录页，填写表单并提交。

say.text: 搜索“天气”并返回第一条结果

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a browser: open pages, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, record videos, etc. It uses the agent-browser CLI to perform these actions and returns page content or screenshots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to automate web interactions, extract structured data, fill forms, or test web UIs.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Claude will open the page and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Log in to the website with username user and password pass
say_en.note: Claude will open the login page, fill the form, and submit.

say_en.text: Search for 'weather' and return the first result
say_en.note: Claude will open a search engine, type the query, click search, and get results.
